question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Awful
solution:
The correct answer is **"Wonderful."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
• **" Awful" means extremely bad or unpleasant. **(भयंकर)
 
 
• Example: We had an awful meeting today.
 
 
 
• **"Wonderful" means extremely good or enjoyable. **(आश्चर्यजनक)
 
 
• Example: I had a wonderful dinner with my friends.
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the word "wonderful" is opposite in meaning to the word "awful.'

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Pitiful" means deserving or arousing pity. (दयापूर्ण)
 
• "Dreadful" means causing or involving great suffering, fear, or unhappiness. (भयानक)
 
• "Grim" means forbidding or uninviting in appearance. (विकट)
